angularDiameterSource: Computed here from the record's radius and distance: 2 x 588,694 km at 29.36 pc = 0.27 mas. No interferometric diameter of this star is used.
distanceSource: Gaia DR3 parallax 34.0634 +/- 0.0215 mas (same row, RUWE 0.96): 29.36 pc, no zero-point correction
radiusSource: Radius 0.846 (0.829 to 0.864) from Gaia DR3 FLAME (Creevey et al. 2023, A&A 674, A26; astrophysical_parameters of the same source): 588,694 km at 695,700 km per solar radius. Mass 0.837 (0.797 to 0.877) from Gaia DR3 FLAME (Creevey et al. 2023, A&A 674, A26; astrophysical_parameters of the same source); GM is that mass times the JPL solar GM. Temperature 5209 +/- 3 K from Andrae et al. (2023), A&A 674, A27 (Gaia DR3 GSP-Phot), astrophysical_parameters of Gaia DR3 3799626935341796096: teff_gspphot 5208.892 K (16th-84th percentiles 5205.1763-5211.172), the temperature FLAME used (https://doi.org/10.1051/0004-6361/202243462). presentationUp: the display axis is a sky-plane convention; the spin axis's position angle on the sky is not measured.
effectiveTemperatureSource: Andrae et al. (2023), A&A 674, A27 (Gaia DR3 GSP-Phot), astrophysical_parameters of Gaia DR3 3799626935341796096: teff_gspphot 5208.892 K (16th-84th percentiles 5205.1763-5211.172), the temperature FLAME used (https://doi.org/10.1051/0004-6361/202243462)
surfaceGravitySource: log g from the mass and radius in packages/astronomy/data/bodies/flegetonte.json (sources in its physicalNotes), log10(GM/R^2) in cgs: 4.506, rounded to two decimals
spectralTypeSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of HD 102195 (pscomppars): spectral type K0 V, from Paredes et al. 2021 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2021AJ....162..176P/abstract)
metallicitySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of HD 102195 (pscomppars): [Fe/H] 0.04 dex, from Stassun et al. 2017 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2017AJ....153..136S/abstract)
luminositySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of HD 102195 (pscomppars): log10 of the luminosity in solar units -0.33442, from Ge et al. 2006 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2006ApJ...648..683G/abstract)
ageSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of HD 102195 (pscomppars): age 2.4 Gyr, from Ge et al. 2006 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2006ApJ...648..683G/abstract)
rotationPeriodSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of HD 102195 (pscomppars): rotation period 12.3 d, from Ge et al. 2006 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2006ApJ...648..683G/abstract)
projectedRotationSpeedSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of HD 102195 (pscomppars): projected rotation speed 3.23 km/s, from Ge et al. 2006 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2006ApJ...648..683G/abstract)
spinInclinationSource: Computed here from this record's rotation period, projected rotation speed and radius (0.846 solar radii): sin i = v sin i × P / (2πR) = 0.928. Not a measurement of the axis: the three numbers come from different papers.

shape.qualification: A sphere at the published radius, colored from a blackbody at the star's published temperature (photometry/stellar-color.json); no image of the photosphere exists.
